chapter: Later ventures, lodges and San Francisco recollections
title: What became of Slocum Mitchell and the surviving bandsmen
summary: Slocum Mitchell died in Los Angeles; Spikes is the last living member of the So Different band and over half of his big band are gone.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And we were talking about Adam Slocum Mitchell, and you told me you'd tell me what happened to him. Well, you followed his career for awhile, and then what? He went with some band that was
travelling, and after that, do you know what ever happened to him? Did he...
Oh, he died here. We didn't follow his career that far.
He died. Nearly all the bands did.. All of them boys on the So Different Band--all of them are dead. I'm the only one that's living. Now, on the other band, over half of them's dead.
Oh. You mean your other band?
Yeah. The big band...that you got here from Sunnyland. You know, on the picture. Over half of them is dead..
